question: What is the authoritative e9patch full-corpus parity/determinism column at current main c7531a83, resolving the scope caveat left by the 7-cell recheck?
answer: On the 184 ptrace-green cells, e9patch is 183/184 (99.46%) on BOTH parity and determinism; the single residual e9patch-specific gap is rcx-canonicalization (inherent instruction relocation). Zero parity-only gaps. The stale 82a8e853 column (det 179/200, parity 173) is superseded.

measurement.corpus: 235-cell e2e union corpus (grown from the 200-cell corpus behind the 82a8e853 column)

sole_e9patch_specific_gap.class: inherent: e9tool relocates the in-ELF syscall into a trampoline, so the guest's own SYSRET %rcx return-RIP != inline label; unfixable without abandoning interception

unmeasured_are_not_e9patch_gaps: the 21 parity-unmeasured cells are ones where ptrace itself fails --strict (qemu-*, thread-contention, ipc/signal/mmap-determinism, shell-pipeline, pmu-skid, etc.); e9patch mirrors ptrace, neither credited nor blamed
